## Houston 1.0.4

### Fixes and polish

- **The first reply in a new chat finishes sooner.** For AI Employees running in the cloud, Houston now names the conversation while the reply is written, not after it. That saves about 3 seconds.
- **Replies start faster in chats with many shared images.** Your AI Employee no longer waits for every earlier image to load before it starts answering.
- **The Houston icon shows in your browser tab on every Houston site**, in white on dark tabs.
- Additional reliability improvements under the hood.

### Before you upgrade

- Quit Houston before installing. macOS doesn't always replace a running app. If in doubt, delete Houston from Applications and drag the new copy in.
